drivingQuestion: Who counts as a minor exempt from the mitzva of appearance?
outcomeNote: Unit breaks off at the opening of R' Zeira's objection; it continues in chagigah.sugya016

segments.he: אֵי זֶהוּ קָטָן — כׇּל שֶׁאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לִרְכּוֹב עַל כְּתֵפוֹ שֶׁל אָבִיו. מַתְקֵיף לַהּ רַבִּי זֵירָא:
segments.en: § The mishna taught: «Who is a minor» who is exempt from the mitzva of appearance in the Temple? «Any» child «who is unable to ride on his father’s shoulders» and ascend from Jerusalem to the Temple Mount. «Rabbi Zeira strongly objects to this:»
